If we define the slope at each point on the curve by the slope of the cor- responding tangent line, we obtain a new function that gives the slope of the curve f(x) at each point x. We call this new function the ­derivative of f(x) and repre­sent it with df/dx. We have already calculated the derivatives of two functions:
